data.note: Golden recording of GET /api/agents?stream=1 frames from a real daemon. Line 1 is this metadata record; every following line is one AgentRegistrySseEvent as { event, data }. `frameCount` counts those following lines; `agentFrameCount` counts the `agent` frames among them, the rest being the single terminal `done`.
data.command: OD_DATA_DIR=<scratch> pnpm tools-dev run web --namespace gauntlet-w3-3b --daemon-port 20321 --web-port 20322   # then:   curl -sN -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "http://127.0.0.1:20321/api/agents?stream=1&refresh=1"
data.normalization: The recording is verbatim except that the operator home directory was replaced by <HOME> and the worktree path by <WORKTREE> inside string values. No field was added, dropped, or retyped.
